investigations.name: TSH
investigations.plain_note: TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone) is a blood test that reflects how the pituitary gland signals the thyroid.

investigations.name: Free T4
investigations.plain_note: Free T4 measures the level of one of the main thyroid hormones circulating in the blood.

investigations.name: Anti-TPO
investigations.plain_note: Anti-TPO is an antibody test sometimes used when investigating thyroid conditions.
